gloss: to be compatible; to go well together

definitions.gloss: to be compatible; to get along well; to be a good match
definitions.explanation: Describes a natural compatibility between people, things, or combinations. Can refer to personal relationships, food pairings, technology compatibility, and more.

examples.japanese: あの{二人|ふたり}は{相性|あいしょう}がいい。
examples.english: Those two are compatible with each other.

examples.japanese: チーズとワインは{相性|あいしょう}がいい。
examples.english: Cheese and wine go well together.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいソフトウェアとこのパソコンは{相性|あいしょう}がいいようで、{問題|もんだい}なく{動|うご}いている。
examples.english: The new software seems to be compatible with this computer — it's running without any problems.

notes:
{相性|あいしょう} originally comes from fortune-telling and astrology, where it referred to the compatibility between two people's birth signs. Today it is used broadly for any kind of natural compatibility or affinity.

The opposite expression is {相性|あいしょう}が{悪|わる}い (to be incompatible).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {相性|あいしょう}がいい: compatible, a good match
- {相性|あいしょう}が{悪|わる}い: incompatible, a bad match
- {相性|あいしょう}が{合|あ}う: to be compatible
- {相性|あいしょう}{抜群|ばつぐん}: perfect compatibility
- {相性|あいしょう}{診断|しんだん}: compatibility test

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {気|き}が{合|あ}う: to get along — focuses on personality and temperament between people
- {馬|うま}が{合|あ}う: to hit it off — an idiomatic expression for personal chemistry
- {合|あ}う: to suit, to match — a more general term for things fitting together
